try: See every task in the studio in one list
how:
1. Click "Tasks" in the side navigation — its red number is your own overdue tasks, so it opens on "My Tasks" with "Overdue" on
2. Click the "My Tasks" pill › "All Tasks"
expect: "Tasks" first shows only your overdue tasks (an "Overdue · n" chip lit); with "All Tasks" it lists every lead's tasks and the studio's own, with a "Lead" column. The side navigation's Tasks item counts your overdue ones.

try: Add a studio chore that belongs to no lead
how:
1. Click "Add Task" › "Create New Task"
2. Type Order new sample boards for the showroom, leave the Lead cell on "Studio", press Enter, then Esc
3. Click the "All Tasks" chip › "Studio Tasks"
expect: "Task added" and the new task stays at the top of the list, glowing once; Studio Tasks lists it with the studio's other chores (e.g. "Update the showroom price list for Q4"), each reading "Studio" as its Lead.

how:
1. Switch the chip back to "All Tasks"
2. Click the "Filters" icon, open "Lead" and tick Sophia Wong
3. Click "Done"
expect: Only Sophia Wong's tasks from the earlier chapters remain; the Filters icon shows 1.

try: Catch up on the week in the bell
how:
1. Click "Notifications" (the bell) in the side navigation
2. Read the list
expect: Two groups: "Due" comes first while a follow-up is late (e.g. "… has had no contact yet"), then "Notices", newest first — e.g. Sarah's proposed item and her quote for approval.
in10: Different from 1.0: follow-ups due are listed, not scheduled

try: Open a notice and land on its record
how:
1. In the bell, click a row that has a dot
2. Note where you land
3. Open the bell again
expect: The notice's record opens (a lead, a quote or My Items); back in the bell, that row has lost its dot.

try: Clear the unread notices in one go
how:
1. In the bell, click "Mark all as read" (the ✓ at the top)
2. Read the message at the bottom
expect: Every dot goes; the message says "All caught up" or that the follow-ups due stay until done; the "Due" rows remain.
in10: Different from 1.0: a follow-up stays until the work is done

try: Jump from the bell to the notification rules and back
how:
1. In the bell, click "Notification settings"
2. Read "Your notifications": "As they happen" or "A daily summary", and "Choose what reaches you"
3. Click the back arrow, top left
expect: Your profile opens on "Your notifications" — how your emails come (As they happen · A daily summary) and the notices you can switch off for yourself; notices the studio has switched off read "Off for the whole studio". Which notices go out at all stays in Settings › Notifications (the card links to it). Back returns you.
in10: Different from 1.0: each person mutes notices or takes a daily summary

try: See how fast the team answers and wins leads
how:
1. Open Leads and click "Insights" (the chart icon)
2. Read the three tiles and "By team member"
3. Click "All time"
expect: It opens Company › Reports on "Leads" (its Back returns to Leads); tiles "Creation → Assignment", "Assignment → First outreach", "First outreach → Won" show medians; "All time" updates the "… leads in range" count.
in10: Different from 1.0: a Company › Reports tab; Won instead of Signed

try: See how quickly Sophia Wong was handled
how:
1. Open Sophia Wong
2. In the "Lead stages" card read "Response time"
3. Click it
expect: It reads like "Assigned in … · First contact in … · Won in …"; clicking it opens Company › Reports on "Leads".
in10: Different from 1.0: one line instead of a separate card

try: Read Sophia Wong's whole story on one timeline
how:
1. Open Sophia’s project › "Files & notes" › "Activity" (once Won, her lead hands Activity to the project)
2. Scroll the list
3. Type contract in the search box
expect: Her whole story, newest first: created, assigned, contacted, quoted, contract, Won, then the project’s own lines — each dated; the search leaves only the contract lines.
in10: Different from 1.0: built from the records, and searchable

try: Find Sophia's quote among all the studio's quotes
how:
1. Click "Tools" › "Quotes"
2. Type Sophia in the search box
expect: "Quotes" lists every lead's quotes with a "Client" column; Sophia Wong's quote shows its number, status and total.

try: Find Sophia's signed contract among all contracts
how:
1. Click "Tools" › "Contracts"
2. Type Sophia in the search box
expect: "Contracts" lists the studio's contracts with a "Lead" column; Sophia Wong's contract reads "Signed".

try: Find last week's rival-quote comparison again
how:
1. Click "Tools" › "Quote X-Ray"
2. Look at "Recent comparisons"
3. Click the Sophia Wong row
expect: A row "Sophia Wong · vs …" (the rival from chapter 7) with its date; it opens the saved comparison.
in10: Different from 1.0: every comparison kept, not just the last five
